issues: Floating 'Obserrian Advisor' popover (bottom-right) can overlap tab bar / buttons on smaller viewports — carry-over from iter132, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: ai_advisor.py::advisor_explain uses _EXPLAIN_CACHE key=(org_id, kind, title) which does NOT include ground_only_context. If two callers use the same title+kind with different ground_only_context values within 5 minutes, the second caller receives the first caller's cached payload (impact fields leak, or are missing incorrectly). Include ground_only_context in the cache key to keep the two branches isolated.

crisis_commander.py::crisis_insight uses cache key ck=(org_id, ref, events_count, actions_count) — will not invalidate on regulatory/recovery/participant changes. Consider adding recovery/obligation counts (or a case updated_at) to the key so the panel refreshes when regulatory clocks or recovery states move without a new event.
AIExplain default cache in AIExplain.jsx should also fold groundOnly into its _key (spec confirms it does) — verified via prop wiring; keep an eye on any consumer that mutates groundOnly at runtime.
connectors/catalog response shape: verify long-term contract (list vs. grouped-by-category dict) — current backend test tolerates both; recommend fixing one canonical shape and documenting it.
